rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for both the pumpkin plant and its fruit.

example.english: This pumpkin makes very sweet soup.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 naam4 gwaa1 bou1 tong1 hou2 tim4

rows.note: Use this as an alternative Cantonese name for either the pumpkin plant or its fruit.

example.english: The pumpkin at home is ripe; let's use it to make soup.
example.traditional: 我屋企個番瓜熟喇，拎嚟煲湯啦。
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 go3 faan1 gwaa1 suk6 laa3 ling1 lai4 bou1 tong1 laa1
